nodes.title: Hold the search state in signals
nodes.why: results, isLoading and error are written from debounce and delay callbacks after the input event is over; a signal write is what marks the OnPush view for refresh at that point.
nodes.alternative: Plain fields with default change detection, relying on zone.js to run a global check after every timer callback.
nodes.tradeoff: The template calls results(), isLoading() and error() instead of reading fields, and in return the view stays correct under OnPush and without zone.js.

nodes.title: Wait for a 500ms pause in typing
nodes.why: A burst of keystrokes reaches the search only once typing stops for 500ms, so fakeApiSearch runs once per pause instead of once per character typed into the box.
nodes.alternative: Search on every input event, or throttle so the first keystroke of each window searches at once.
nodes.tradeoff: Results show up at least 500ms after the last keystroke, which is the price for never loading the intermediate prefixes of a name.

nodes.title: Clear the results for an empty term
nodes.why: A blank or whitespace-only term empties results and stops the loading flag, and the switchMap branch answers with of([]), so fakeApiSearch never receives an empty query.
nodes.alternative: Pass the empty string to fakeApiSearch and let it decide whether to return everything or nothing.
nodes.tradeoff: The empty case is checked twice, in tap and in switchMap, but clearing the box resets the list without a 600ms round trip.

nodes.title: Cancel the request for an older term
nodes.why: When a newer term clears the debounce while a request is still in flight, switchMap unsubscribes from it, so a late response for Bob cannot replace the results for Alice.
nodes.alternative: mergeMap or concatMap, which keep every request alive and let an older response land after a newer one.
nodes.tradeoff: Work already started for the old term is thrown away, which suits a search box but would be wrong for saves that must all finish.

nodes.title: Catch errors inside the inner stream
nodes.why: catchError wraps only the fakeApiSearch call, so a failed search sets error, clears isLoading and yields an empty list while the outer searchTerm$ subscription keeps listening.
nodes.alternative: Place catchError after switchMap on the outer pipe, where the first failure completes the stream and later typing never searches again.
nodes.tradeoff: Each request carries its own handler, one more level of nesting in exchange for a box that keeps searching after a failed request, such as the one for the term error.

nodes.title: End the pipeline with the component
nodes.why: takeUntilDestroyed completes the subscription when the component is destroyed, which also drops a pending debounce timer or a fake request that has not answered yet.
nodes.alternative: A destroy$ Subject completed in ngOnDestroy, or a stored Subscription that ngOnDestroy unsubscribes.
nodes.tradeoff: The pipeline is built in a method, so DestroyRef has to be injected and passed in, but no lifecycle hook or extra Subject is needed.
